ABOUT CONFERENCE
2
nd International Scientific Conference
“Science, Education, Innovations and Chemical Technologies – From Idea to Implementation” 2023
The aim of the conference is sharing the results and achievements of the latest fundamental and
technological research with representatives of broad and interdisciplinary scientific schools of chemistry
and related fields, planning possible joint research, based on research methodologies and experience,
deepening partnership in order to create innovative technologies, among them with potential to beappropriate to framework of the regional socio-economic development strategy of “Horizon Europe”,
finding potential partners in the production/applied sector to develop their interest in financing
scientific/applied projects
The conference topics are:
Nano processes and nanotechnologies:
Nano powders
Nano coatings
Nano sensors
Fundamentals of processing of minerals and secondary raw materials and technological aspects:
Fundamental and technological aspects of processing natural resources
Fundamental and technological aspects of recycling of secondary raw materials and industrial waste
Green Chemistry:
Innovative technologies in the development of new materials
New methods of cleaning natural and wastewater
Energy and ecology
Promotion and commercialization of scientific innovations:
Protection and promotion of research results
Innovative technologies and public-private partnership
Corporate-social responsibility in the field of innovation
Energy:
Sources
Conversion
Storage
No fee is charged to conference participants!

Stefano Bellucci
INFN-Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati, Frascati, Italia
Presentation title: Innovative 2D material for nanoelectronics, molecular sensing, optical properties, and cationic pollutant removal from aqueous solutions
Professor Bellucci
is First Researcher at INFN-Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati and works to determine significant advances in knowledge in the pre-eminent field of activity (scientific research in theoretical and applied physics). He also serves as Chief Technology Officer at Small Medium Enterprise (R.A.I.T.88) and startup Company RAITHOR Collaborating in a coordinated and continuous way for the realization of the production processes inherent the graphene and/or other nanotechnology products, coordinating the company R&D activities.
More details see
LINK
Dilgam Babir Tagiyev
National Academy of Science of Azerbaijan, Institute of Catalysis and Inorganic Chemistry named after academician M. Nagiyev, Baku, Azerbaijan
Presentation title: Nanoelectrochemistry and Eleclrocatalysis
Academician Dilgam Tagiyev is a Vice President of National Academy of Science of Azerbaijan and General Director of the Institute of Catalysis and Inorganic Chemistry named after academician M. Nagiyev, Baku, Azerbaijan. He has been devoted to the development and study of the mechanism of influence of heterogeneous and homogeneous catalysts for hydrogenation, oxidation, isomerization, alkylation, oxydehydrogenation, oligomerization and other reactions of various class hydrocarbons and their derivatives, synthesis and research of biologically active metal-complexes, study and modeling of some physical and chemical processes.
More details see:
LINK
Venko N. Beschkov
Institute of Chemical Engineering, Bulgarian Academy of Sciences, Sofia, Bulgaria
Presentation title: Carbon-free chemical sources of energy: the hydrogen sulfide
Professor Venko N. Beschkov  is a researcher at the Institute of Chemical Engineering, Bulgarian Academy of Sciences (since 2014). His scope of scientific activity is Mass transfer operations, treatment and recycling of industrial waste, bioprocess engineering (fine chemicals production, waste water treatment, gas pollution removal, Chemical and Biochemical Processes for Utilization of Renewable Energy Sources, etc.). He obtained 17 patents and participated in more than 30 projects, were related to environment protection – 20.
He is member of editorial board of number of journals: Current Biochemical Engineering (since 2013), ChemEngineering (since 2021), Catalysts (since 2021).
More details see:
LINK
Fred Lisdat
Institute of Life Sciences and Biomedical Technologies, Wildau University of Technology, Wildau, Germany
Presentation Topic on:
Biosystems engineering
Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Fred Lisdat is a Chair of the Institute of Applied Life Sciences at the Wildau University of Technology, and head of the biosystems engineering group. His Scientific Interests cover: biosensors, enzymatic recycling schemes, metabolite sensors, detection of reactive oxygen species and antioxidants, direct protein electrochemistry, label-free detection of DNA and DNA binding molecules and proteins, impedimetric detection of proteins and nucleic acids, artificial protein arrangements on electrodes, electron transfer through protein multilayers, protein engineering, quantum dots on electrodes for sensing applications, biofuel cells, carbon nanostructures, conducting polymers, macroporous electrodes, photobioelectrochemistry. 2022 Prof. Lisdat elected President of the “Bioelectrochemical Society”.
More details see:
LINK

Institute of Catalysis and Inorganic Chemistry named after academician M. Nagiyev, Baku, Azerbaijan
Presentation title: Nanoelectrochemistry and Electrocatalysis

heterosystems creation as an anodic material for photoelectrolysis of water. Mechanism of electrochemical obtaining process of  Cd chalcogenides as studied in detail. He is Co-founder and executive secretary of Journal of “Chemical Problems” (ISSN: 2221-8688) that is indexed in SCOPUS.

Institute for Catalysis, Hokkaido University, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
He was appointed as a Professor at Hokkaido University in 2006 and is currently supervising his research group at the Institute for Catalysis. His research interest includes π-electronic and chiral polymers and supramolecules, photo-chemical asymmetric synthesis, and polymer catalysis, etc.

senior researcher and professor, majoring in physics and chemistry. Department of International Political Science, University of Siena, Siena, Italy
he is assistant professor for this department, where he teach International history and technology. Haybusak University, Yerevan, Armenia
An expert in the field of environmental research and management, that covers a wide range of investigations, including the interdisciplinary ecological studies of fresh water and the air, climate change and human health. Professional activity convers 7-year experience of the project manager in NATO SfP/OSCE “ South Caucasus River Monitoring “ regional program, 8-year activity as an international expert of European Cooperative Water program” ICP Waters”, 8 year experience as an national expert of State Committee of Science of Armenia. Department of Political Sciences, University of Gdansk, Gdask, Poland
Professor in Department of Political Science at the University of Gdansk, Poland and Vasul’ Stus Donetsk National University in Vinnitsya, Ukraine, external supervisor of PhD students at the Faculty of Social and Economic Sciences at Comenius University in Bratislava, Slovakia and member of faculty of Doctoral School in Political Science at the Federico II Naples University. He is a political philosopher specializing in issues of European identity, universalistic political philosophy, political ideologies and currently in populism in the current Poland. INSTRUCTIONS FOR AUTHORS
The Journal “Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of Georgia, Chemical Series” is committed to the publishing of original findings in the field of Chemistry.
Manuscripts should be submitted in English language
. The manuscript, must be accompanied by the Abstracts (not more than 150 words each) written in English and Georgian languages. The content of the Articles should consist of – the introduction, objectives, methods, results, conclusion and 4-6 key words. The total volume of manuscript including abstract, introduction, materials and methods, results, discussion, references and figure legends, should be not more than 6 pages (A4 format) see tamplate. In the list of references, papers should be numbered and given in alphabetical order according to the surname of the first author. References should be cited in the text by the corresponding numbers given in square brackets. The reference list must include: authors (surname and initials), name of the journal (the book), year of publication, volume, number and first and last pages. In the case of books, you must specify the name of the city and publisher, proceedings – should also provide the names and initials of editors.
A manuscript must be submitted to info@conference23iice.ge
The name of files should begin with the first author’s surname.
The deadline for paper submission is January 26th, 2024
Please use the Times New Roman for English and Sylfaen for Georgian (font size – 10). Line spacing – 1.5, margins: left – 3 cm, top and bottom – 2.5 cm, right – 1.5 cm. The illustrations can be Black and white or Color graphics.
The phone number and e-mail of the corresponding author should be indicated on the last page of manuscript.
